title: Majorities in Both Parties Say Media Criticism Keeps Politicians in Check
summary: Overall, 80% of Americans express this view, up from 75% in September 2025. Another 16% say such criticism keeps political leaders from doing their job.

title: Gas Prices Are High Now, but for Many Americans They Were Even Higher in the Past
summary: Gas prices have surged amid the Iran conflict, but adjusted for inflation and wages, 2008 was costlier.

title: Americans Are Open to AI in Healthcare, but Want Humans Making Final Calls
summary: Americans are generally open to AI handling administrative and medical tasks, but they largely don’t want AI operating without human oversight. About half (47%) say AI will make the relationship between patients and their doctors worse, compared with 10% who say it will make it better.
